title: THE FINALE: Race to the Finish

steps.clueRiddle:
The finish line sits three hours west.
One championship game stands in your way.
steps.clueReveal: Drive west on Highway 401 toward home. Play the championship round.

challenges.title: Bagel Catch Championship
challenges.instructions: Slide the basket to catch falling bagels. Dodge the pigeons. Beat your best score.

steps.funFact: Your race has covered about 1,500 kilometres in eight days.

steps.clueRiddle:
A giant apple watches the highway go by.
Inside there is pie. Outside there is a putter.
steps.clueReveal: Stop at The Big Apple. Play mini-golf, then taste the famous apple pie.

challenges.title: The Final Challenge
challenges.instructions: Play mini-golf head-to-head against a parent. Enter both final scores below. Lowest score wins!

challenges.title: Apple Pie Verdict
challenges.instructions: Try the famous apple pie. Chew slowly and think. Give your final rating.
challenges.photoPrompt: Snap a picture of you eating it!

steps.funFact: The Big Apple is so big that you can walk around inside it.

steps.clueRiddle:
One puzzle left before you see home.
Remember every stop — piece the whole trip together.
steps.clueReveal: Almost there! Play one last game about your whole journey. Match every photo to its stop, in order.

challenges.title: Photo Finish
challenges.instructions: Look at photos from your whole trip. Match each one to its stop. Put them in the right order.

steps.funFact: You visited eight cities and took hundreds of photos this week.

steps.location: HOME — Ajax, Ontario · THE FINISH LINE
steps.clueRiddle:
The very last clue is the easiest one.
Your own front door is the finish line.
steps.clueReveal: Drive home to Ajax. Run to the mat on your own driveway. This is the finish line!
steps.funFact: Eight legs, two provinces, one champion. Welcome home.
